next_legitimate_job_only.trigger: A genuinely new eligible source or the actual existing management date; do not queue/replay a job solely for this followup.
next_legitimate_job_only.root_handoff: Root must explicitly provide this ticket and the fixed supplement files alongside the authoritative next packet. Check then-current case/head/lease, file hashes and old source snapshot/current usability; no past job editing or backdated completion.
next_legitimate_job_only.worker_comparison: Read authoritative packet kind/stage, original conditions and prior_review first. Treat this supplement as dated historical context from a previously reviewed source; compare changes and remaining gaps with the actual pending sources.
next_legitimate_job_only.source_reviews: Review exactly each actual pending source, with its own frozen quote/SHA. Do not add the previously reviewed original as an extra pending review or cite its followup quote as though it were in a different new source.
next_legitimate_job_only.case_observation_evidence_source_ids: Only actual frozen pending IDs. An old source in reviewed_sources is not permitted here merely because it was read again.
next_legitimate_job_only.due_only_job: If the legitimate management job has no pending sources, source_reviews and evidence_source_ids remain empty. No supports/counterevidence without actual pending evidence. The outcome follows the actual review; do not precommit a future outcome. A due occurrence must explicitly set a genuinely supported future management date or unset with a reason; retain is not allowed.
next_legitimate_job_only.summary_required_context: State that the prior missing acquisition cost, provisional goodwill and inclusion period have already been clarified by the dated saved p12/13 followup, not by a new issuer announcement or automatic packet discovery.
next_legitimate_job_only.case_observation_rationale_required_cont: Name the same issue and preserve the supplement path/SHA/read_at, original source ID/native snapshot, transaction vs deemed acquisition dates, May-June inclusion, cash consideration versus unknown net CF/timing, provisional PPA/goodwill and omitted proforma not zero. Separate these known facts from remaining like-for-like contribution/tax/cash/normalCF gaps and from any genuinely new pending-source evidence.
next_legitimate_job_only.propagation: Include the resolved/remaining substance in summary and case_observation.rationale, not only source_reviews.rationale or an external README: only summary/case_observation are projected by the next prior_review. Keep result to the existing five fields; no new top-level attachment field.
next_legitimate_job_only.before_any_question: Check the dated supplement and public facts again when preparing a question; remove already answered cost/period/provisional-goodwill/proforma questions. Do not ask for investor normal-profit/tax assumptions or future guarantees.
next_legitimate_job_only.parent_acceptance: Root/independent reviewer checks this handoff was actually read and that output keeps known/residual boundaries before completing the legitimate job. This is a human workflow check, not an existing machine-enforced attachment receipt.

proven_native_behavior.append_on_legitimate_job_complete: Existing complete appends a new case version with the same config_revision and writes immutable result/job/attempt completion transactionally; future prior_review binds that result SHA and carries summary/case_observation.
proven_native_behavior.mechanical_limits: Supplement file SHA/ref/contents placed inside narrative are saved as text but are not typed/frozen supplementary evidence or automatically revalidated by current code. Future prior_review authenticates the result, not the continued existence/meaning of that outside file. Pending evidence and existing reviewed sources still have their standard gates.
